decision_conditions:
CAR FREE DEVELOPMENT: All future occupiers of the residential units hereby approved shall not be eligible to obtain an on street residents parking permit except: 
i) In the case of disabled persons; 
ii) In the case of units designated in this planning permission as 'non car free'; or 
iii) In the case of the resident who is an existing holder of a residents parking permit issued by the London Borough of Islington and has held the permit for a period of at least one year. 

REASON: To ensure that the development remains car free in accordance with policy T6 of the London Plan 2021, policy T3 of the Islington Local Plan: Strategic and Development Management Policies 2023 and Schedule 2, Part 3, Class MA, sub–Paragraph MA.2(2)(a) of The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).
description: Notification of Prior Approval for the change of use of the whole of the building in existing commercial use (Class E) to residential accommodation to provide 9x self-contained residential units (Class C3) under 'Class MA' of Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order (GPDO) 2015 (as amended)
